sources.snippet: The scoring helpers are in utils.py. Run it section by section, not with "Run all". Restart the runtime (Runtime > Restart session) before the 7B QLoRA section, because the 7B model needs the whole GPU. The notebook saves data, results and adapters to a text2sql-lora folder on Google Drive.
